neighbours.label: the token ' per' in 'perished' during disaster, war, or fatality accounts (Layer 35 output unit suppressing ' per'/'Per' logits)
fire: Nearly all members of the Arctic survey team perished in the whiteout before supply sleds reached camp.
Several fishermen were feared to have perished after the trawler capsized off the rocky headland.
The entire crew of the merchant schooner had perished before rescuers located the drifting hull.
Dozens of trapped miners also perished in the tunnel collapse despite round-the-clock excavation efforts.
Many of the refugees fleeing across the mountain pass perished in the sudden November blizzard.
Four explorers were believed to have perished while crossing the flooded canyon during the monsoon.
Chroniclers recorded that most of the besieged garrison perished before relief columns arrived at dawn.
More than thirty passengers aboard the river steamer had perished when the boiler exploded near the pier.
quiet: Nearly all members of the Arctic survey team died in the whiteout before supply sleds reached camp.
Several fishermen were feared to have drowned after the trawler capsized off the rocky headland.
The entire crew of the merchant schooner had vanished before rescuers located the drifting hull.
Dozens of trapped miners also succumbed in the tunnel collapse despite round-the-clock excavation efforts.
Many of the refugees fleeing across the mountain pass froze in the sudden November blizzard.
Four explorers were believed to have disappeared while crossing the flooded canyon during the monsoon.
Relief workers warned that stranded livestock might perish unless hay deliveries arrived before frost.
Surveyors walked the full perimeter of the harbor breakwater to inspect storm damage near the pier.

notes: Layer 35 output pole (max 676.00) whose direct logit effect strongly suppresses ' per', ' Per', 'per', ' permutation', ' perimeter'. Tokenizer splits ' perished' into [' per', 'ished'] while ' perish' is one token. Probing confirmed fatality contexts with 'perished' peak on ' per' (0.13-0.72) whereas synonyms (died, drowned, disappeared) and 'perish'/'perimeter' stay <= 0.04.
